newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Jan rubber output for tyres up 3.1 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Jan rubber output for tyres up 3.1 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japanese rubber output for tyres totalled 82,590 tonnes in January, up 3.1 percent from the same month the previous year but down 7.2 percent from December, the Japan Automobile Tyre Manufacturers' Association said on Wednesday.
Domestic rubber shipments in January amounted to 47,189 tonnes, up 9.9 percent from the previous year but down 7.8 percent from December, the industry body said.
Exports of rubber for tyres in January totalled 36,715 tonnes, up 1.1 percent from the same month a year earlier and up 0.4 percent from December, it said.
